items.question: Is the placement service free for candidates?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely free for job seekers. We are paid by the hiring company, never by the candidate.

items.question: What industries do you work with?
items.answer: Banking, IT, BPO, logistics, healthcare, retail and more. We work with 1,200+ companies across India.

items.question: How long does placement take?
items.answer: Typically 2–4 weeks from CV submission to offer letter, depending on the role and your profile.
